messages:
maria.g: FYI partner ACMEEdge asked if we can report a single 'Cloud+Edge Bundle' line item in marketplace exports instead of two separate SKUs. They want seat split attribution and per-device on-prem hours tied to entitlements.

raj.patel: we currently emit separate usage rows: tokens (hosted) and hw_hours (onprem). what exactly do they want in the ledger?

david_k: sounds like a mapping layer problem. are they requesting a synthetic SKU in marketplace with allocation rules?

maria.g: yes — they want a bundle SKU (acme_bundle_v1) that maps to 70% hosted token charges and 30% onprem minutes for their billing system. also need a per-seat breakdown for seat-based customers.

sarah-ops: this impacts entitlement reconciliation. do they want the entitlement to be a single GUID that we emit to partners, or two entitlements with a bundle alias?

raj.patel: prefer single canonical entitlement_id on our side to avoid double-counting, and then include a breakdown object in the usage payload. but marketplace exports are CSV currently.

marketplace-bot: NOTE: marketplace CSV contract v3 does not support nested objects.

david_k: we can either: 1) add synthetic rows per bundle component (two rows, each tagged with bundle_id) OR 2) emit a single bundle row and include a reference to a separate breakdown file (JSON) delivered via S3. both have tradeoffs.

maria.g: partner asked explicitly for a single row in the marketplace portal — they said downstream systems expect bundle-level aggregation. they can accept a secondary breakdown API if we provide it.

raj.patel: proposed pattern: send bundle row in CSV with columns: bundle_id, bundle_sku, total_units, attribution_signature. Then publish a signed breakdown JSON at s3://partner-breakdowns/<bundle_id>/<date>.json with component rows (component_sku, units, ratio). The signature ensures non-repudiation.

sarah-ops: +1. question: how do we handle idempotency and replays? currently each usage row has a usage_id and event_ts. for bundles we need a canonical bundle_usage_id derived deterministically.

david_k: use sha256(partner_id|date|bundle_sku|batch_seq) as bundle_usage_id. include event_window_start/end. that will make replays idempotent.

maria.g: partner compliance asks for timezone normalization to UTC and a daily window. they're ok with per-day bundle rows.

raj.patel: edge case: partial day device hours that cross midnight and belong to different billing days. we'll sum to the partner's day after normalizing. document this in the contract.

sarah-ops: we also need mapping rules for seat-splitting: for orgs with 10 seats using both hosted and onprem, they want seats assigned proportionally by usage. Who owns that calc?

maria.g: partner prefers Redwood to compute seat splits and include seat_allocation field in breakdown JSON. legal asked we include a tolerance field (+/- 1 seat) for rounding.

david_k: implementation plan:
```
- API: add bundle_manifest endpoint (signed) with breakdown + seat_allocations
- Export: single CSV row per bundle with bundle_usage_id + breakdown_ref_url + signature
- Reconcile: nightly job that verifies S3 breakdown exists and signature verifies against partner pubkey
- Alert: raise ticket if totals mismatch > 0.5% or seat rounding > tolerance
```

raj.patel: I'll prototype the breakdown JSON schema:
```json
{
  "bundle_id": "acme_bundle_v1",
  "bundle_usage_id": "sha256...",
  "date": "2026-04-10",
  "components": [
    {"sku":"hosted_tokens","units":7000,"ratio":0.7},
    {"sku":"onprem_hours","units":3000,"ratio":0.3}
  ],
  "seat_allocations": [{"org_id":"o-123","seats":10,"hosted":7,"onprem":3}],
  "signature":"base64..."
}
```

maria.g: good. who owns the signature verification? partnerships or marketplace team?

sarah-ops: ops should run the nightly verification job but partnerships must supply partner pubkey and contract details.

david_k: dev plan: I'll add export fields (bundle_id, breakdown_ref, signature) and an idempotency generator. raj can work on JSON schema and S3 write. ops will run verifier.

raj.patel: timeline: prototype in staging by Thu, partner integration demo Fri.

maria.g: pinging @acme-contacts to confirm they can fetch S3 objects. also cc @legal to confirm tolerance wording.

sarah-ops: thumbs up. also add a test harness case for partial-day split and seat rounding in CI.

maria.g: thanks all — I'll update partner PRD and post the contract draft in this thread once legal signs off. :raised_hands:
